title: elsholtzia pseudocristata var. angustifolia
intro: Elsholtzia pseudocristata var. angustifolia, commonly known as a variety of the Elsholtzia plant, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling in the body. The therapeutic actions of Elsholtzia pseudocristata var. angustifolia include its use as an antiseptic and antimicrobial agent, and it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, headaches, and digestive issues.
